title: Evaluation of health risk of glyphosate pesticide intake via water consumption
author: Pakzad, Taheri, et al.

steps.title: Acidify water sample
steps.instruction: Transfer 1 mL of each collected water sample into a tube and add 10 µL of 1 M formic acid; mix briefly.

steps.title: Add derivatization reagents
steps.instruction: To the acid‑treated sample add 50 µL of 5 % tetraborate (borate) buffer and 50 µL of FMOC solution (10 mg/mL FMOC in acetonitrile).

steps.title: Derivatize overnight
steps.instruction: Allow the reaction mixture to stand at room temperature for approximately 12–16 h (overnight) to complete derivatization.

steps.title: Quench reaction
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL of 2 % phosphoric acid to stop the derivatization reaction; mix gently.

steps.title: Remove excess FMOC
steps.instruction: Add 300 µL of methanol to the quenched mixture to extract and remove excess FMOC; vortex briefly.

steps.title: Prepare HPLC‑MS system
steps.instruction: Install a 100 mm BEH C18 XP column (130 Å, 2.5 µm particles, 2.1 mm ID) with a 5 mm XBridge BEH C18 VanGuard pre‑column (same dimensions). Prepare mobile phase A (5 mM ammonium formate in water) and mobile phase B (acetonitrile). Program the gradient: 0–2 min 80 % A / 20 % B, 2–9 min 60 % A / 40 % B, 9–15 min 10 % A / 90 % B. Set the pump flow to 0.4 mL/min.

steps.title: Inject sample
steps.instruction: Inject 4 µL of the prepared sample using the partial‑fill mode of the autosampler.

steps.title: Run MS detection
steps.instruction: Configure the quadrupole MS with: capillary exit voltage –70 V, drying gas 8 mL/min at 300 °C, nebulizer pressure 35 psi, sheath gas 3 mL/min at 150 °C, dwell time 5.79 ms, negative‑mode SIM at m/z 390. Record chromatograms; note LOD = 0.01 ng/mL and LOQ = 0.03 ng/mL for glyphosate.

steps.title: Determine nitrate concentration
steps.instruction: Measure nitrate in each water sample with a DR 5000™ UV–Vis spectrophotometer (Hach, Germany) using the standard colorimetric method.

steps.title: Measure hardness and alkalinity
steps.instruction: Determine total hardness and total alkalinity of each sample by titration according to Standard Methods.

steps.title: Record physicochemical parameters
steps.instruction: Measure solution pH, dissolved oxygen, and electrical conductivity with a calibrated multi‑parameter meter (HQ40d, Hach, Germany).
